parameters.help_en: The start time of the node exception. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard with the time zone. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800. Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the API returns a 400 InvalidParameter (field required) error
parameters.help_zh: 节点异常问题开始时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，带时区的时间格式，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800。注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时接口返回 400 InvalidParameter（field required）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the node exception. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard with the time zone. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800
parameters.help_zh: 节点异常问题结束时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，带时区的时间格式，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The impact of the exception on the Lingjun node. Valid values:
HardwareError: A hardware exception occurs.
SoftwareError: A software exception occurs.
NetworkError: A network exception occurs.
Others: Other exceptions. If none of the preceding impact types apply, set Reason to Others and provide more information in Description
parameters.help_zh:
异常问题对灵骏节点造成的影响。
取值范围（枚举值）：
● HardwareError：硬件出现异常
● SoftwareError：软件出现异常
● NetworkError：网络出现异常
● Others：其他异常问题。当以上影响类型不符合条件时，您可以设置Reason=Others并在Description中描述更多信息
parameters.name: reason

parameters.help_en:
The category of the exception. This parameter is required when Reason is set to HardwareError. Valid values:</br>
hardware-cpu-error: CPU failure.</br>
hardware-gpu-error: GPU failure.</br>
hardware-motherboard-error: Motherboard failure.</br>
hardware-mem-error: Memory failure.</br>
hardware-power-error: Power supply failure.</br>
hardware-disk-error: Disk failure.
hardware-networkcard-error: NIC failure.</br>
hardware-fan-error: Fan failure.</br>
hardware-cable-error: Network cable failure.</br>
others: Others
parameters.help_zh:
异常问题的类别。当Reason=HardwareError时，此值为必填项。取值范围：</br>
● hardware-cpu-error：CPU 故障</br>
● hardware-gpu-error：GPU 故障</br>
● hardware-motherboard-error：主板故障</br>
● hardware-mem-error：内存故障</br>
● hardware-power-error：电源故障</br>
● hardware-disk-error：磁盘故障
● hardware-networkcard-error：网卡故障</br>
● hardware-fan-error：风扇故障</br>
● hardware-cable-error：网线故障</br>
● others：其他
parameters.name: issue_category
